full_page.content:
c. 1945
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of brief message written on pictures and cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
( for Doris Panyard)
on reverse of a photo of Padre Pio, Father Solanus wrote.
December 8th, 49 anniversary of his vocation, say a little wispered prayer for the real conversion of poor
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. SINNER
On another card Fr. Solanus has written:
Prayers for the Missions and for the missionaries is mostly what they need.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 27 Muakwfon, Mich. 4944 1
